reason: They don't name the payment company, the fee per transaction or when the money lands in my account, and those are the only things I need to know. Most of my customers order at the counter anyway, and I already reach my regulars on Instagram and WhatsApp for free.
objection: A hidden per-transaction fee on top of 59 GEL, and not knowing when I get paid. I count the cash and card totals myself every night, and I won't let my money sit with a company I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A named Georgian bank as the payment partner, a written fee lower than my card terminal's, and the money in my account the next day.
